pr_title: Add left-handed spherical and cylindrical billboards
pr_body:
Adds the left-handed `CreateBillboard` and `CreateConstrainedBillboard` variants. The code gen and perf for the new variants are very similar to the existing right-handed versions.

Closes #93046

issue_context.title: [API Proposal]: Billboard Lefthanded APIs for System.Numerics.Matrix4x4
comments:
Tagging subscribers to this area: @dotnet/area-system-numerics See info in [area-owners.md](https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/blob/main/docs/area-owners.md) if you want to be subscribed.
Issue Details
### Background and motivation Matrix4x4 recently added APIs for left handed creation of Matrix4x4. Replacing another matrix implementation led me to nice the billboard APIs did not get left handed equivalents. In order to not confuse people about which functions are actually expecting a right handed system, we should add left handed versions for the billboard APIs. ### API Proposal ```csharp namespace System.Numerics; public partial struct Matrix4x4 { public static Matrix4x4 CreateBillboardLeftHanded(Vector3 objectPosition, Vector3 cameraPosition, Vector3 cameraUpVector, Vector3 cameraForwardVector) public static Matrix4x4 CreateConstrainedBillboardLeftHanded(Vector3 objectPosition, Vector3 cameraPosition, Vector3 rotateAxis, Vector3 cameraForwardVector, Vector3 objectForwardVector) } ### API Usage ```csharp var billboardLeftHanded = CreateBillboardLeftHanded(objectPosition, cameraPosition, cameraUpVector, cameraForwardVector); ... var billboardConstrainedLeftHanded = CreateConstrainedBillboardLeftHanded(objectPosition, cameraPosition, rotateAxis, cameraForwardVector, objectForwardVector); } ### Alternative Designs _No response_ ### Risks _No response_
Author: sqeezy
Assignees: -

review_comments: Please add XML comments to the new public APIs. I realize the existing ones don't have docs, but eventually we want to end up in a place where the XML docs are the source of truth, and in the meantime we use XML docs on new methods to seed the documentation, automatically exporting it as part of the release.
Nevermind, I see that these are on an internal type.

Once this is merged, please also follow up with a PR to update [Matrix4x4.xml (dotnet/dotnet-api-docs)](https://github.com/dotnet/dotnet-api-docs/blob/main/xml/System.Numerics/Matrix4x4.xml#L289). Once seeded from the original comments, we don't automatically flow changes over to the API docs repo.
nit: It's beneficial to ensure corresponding comments are in the right-handed API where relevant, that way devs have context regardless of which they look at.
